title: WhatsApp Bot → Intent → Book, Quote or Hand Off

sections.label: 1 · MESSAGE IN
sections.note: Inbound messages arrive from the messaging API. Conversation memory is keyed on the phone number, so the bot remembers what was already said instead of restarting every message.

sections.label: 2 · UNDERSTAND
sections.note: One pass classifies intent and pulls out whatever detail the message already contains — a date, an address, a service type — so the bot asks only for what is genuinely missing.

sections.label: 3 · ACT
sections.note: Booking requests check live availability, quote requests price from the rate table, and anything the bot is not confident about is handed to a person rather than guessed at.

sections.label: 4 · REPLY & LOG
sections.note: The reply goes back on the same thread and the whole exchange is written to the CRM, so a rep picking it up later has the full history rather than a cold start.

input_sample.message: hey do you guys do same day ac repair? we're in south austin and it's not blowing cold at all

output_sample.reply_sent: We can get someone out today — we've got a 4-6pm or a 6:30-8:30pm window open in South Austin. Which works better? I'll just need the service address to lock it in.
